title: [spec-gap][R-02-010] C N_CHANNELS decoupled from the active regional channel plan (spec 02 3.3)
description: Req R-02-010 (spec/02-physical-link.md 3.3 primitives): N_CHANNELS = total channels in the active regional channel plan, NOT a global constant. PARTIALLY DIVERGENT: Python derives num_channels = len(plan.channels) (channel_plan.py:73-75) with full regional plans; Rust is fully parameterized (select_channel(..., n_channels), synchronized_hop_channel(..., n_channels), no N_CHANNELS=8 constant in rust/). C: CONFIG_LICHEN_N_CHANNELS int default 8 range 1-16 (lichen/subsys/lichen/link/Kconfig:277-284) consumed at lora_l2_tx.c:364,369; board confs pin 8 (t1000_e_nrf52840.conf:7, thinknode_m3_nrf52840.conf:7); the op-class regional table (hal/include/lichen/op_class.h:35-69) has NO channel-count field, so nothing ties the Kconfig value to a regional plan — a US915 build (64 channels) cannot be expressed (range caps at 16). Also: US915 '8 downlink' has no representation in ANY stack (python US915 = 64 uplink entries only, channel_plan.py:139-150) — spec text is LoRaWAN-specific and likely needs amendment (prior Opus verify recommended 'US915: 64 channels'). Suggested placement: add channel-count to C op-class table and derive Kconfig default from it, or wire plan selection; spec-side: drop uplink/downlink wording for US915.
